faqs.question: Why does my converted STL model show faceting on round holes in Bambu Studio?
faqs.answer: This happens when the conversion chordal deviation (mesh deflection) is set too coarse. Re-export the STEP with linear deflection set to 0.01mm or import the STEP file directly into Bambu Studio, which runs an internal high-density tessellation kernel.

faqs.question: Is STEP better for 3D printing than STL?
faqs.answer: Yes. STEP retains mathematically perfect NURBS surfaces, whereas STL approximates everything with flat triangles. Modern slicers (PrusaSlicer 2.5+, Bambu Studio) can slice directly from STEP, calculating slicing layers against true mathematical arcs.

faqs.question: Will converting STEP to STL lose internal assembly components?
faqs.answer: If the STEP file contains a multi-body assembly, standard STL export will merge all bodies into a single solid mesh unless your converter supports multi-body split or you convert to the modern 3MF format.

faqs.question: Why should I convert to 3MF instead of STL for 3D printing?
faqs.answer: 3MF is smaller (compressed XML container), includes explicit millimeter unit headers to prevent scale errors, and preserves multiple assembly parts with distinct colors and materials.

faqs.question: Can all 3D printers read 3MF files?
faqs.answer: Modern slicers (Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, Cura, IdeaMaker, OrcaSlicer) natively support 3MF. Since the slicer generates the final machine G-code, virtually any 3D printer can execute models prepared via 3MF.

faqs.question: Does STEP to 3MF conversion preserve CAD parametric feature trees?
faqs.answer: No. 3MF is an additive manufacturing mesh format. The parametric sketch history and extrude features are baked into polygonal geometry during the conversion process.

faqs.question: How are multi-sheet SolidWorks drawings handled during DWG export?

faqs.answer: This happens if the drawing was exported using Raster Print mode instead of High Quality Vector mode. Vector PDFs store mathematical line paths that remain razor-sharp at any zoom magnification.

faqs.question: Are part numbers and BOM text searchable in the exported PDF?
